comment: The comedor's diners, drawn in place behind the banquet table on the clean plate. Polygons are crop pixels (crop origin 150, 290); each runs from above a standing head down to the table top, so the table stays the plate's. Anchors: the floor under each chair, hidden by the table (marks.json). COMEDOR, 2026-11-08. Key 995000 of 3 drew eight diners, not seven: two women in green side by side (c is recoloured, see figures). 995001 held seven but moved the left candelabrum, which would flicker as single diners' layers change; 995002 also doubled the green dress and hid a candelabrum.

key.prompt: Image 1 is part of a pixel art game background at night: a banquet table with a cream damask tablecloth, soup bowls, wine glasses and two silver candelabra, in front of a wine-red wall. Add seven diners seated in a row on the far side of the table, facing the viewer, all in formal dinner dress, from left to right: an older gentleman with white hair and a short grey beard in a black tailcoat and white bow tie; a woman of about forty with dark hair in a chignon, in an emerald satin evening gown; a plump bald man of about sixty in a burgundy velvet dinner jacket and black bow tie; a young woman with long black hair in a braid, in a gold evening dress; a man of about thirty-five with a neat dark beard, in a navy suit and tie; an elderly woman with a silver updo and a pearl necklace, in a lavender gown with long sleeves; a young man with round glasses, in a grey suit and a dark green bow tie. Each sits on a chair behind the table so only the upper body shows above the tablecloth, eating soup with a spoon, heads bowed a little over the bowls, drawn with a thick dark ink outline in the same crisp pixel art as the picture, at the size the table allows. They are grown-ups of mixed ages, elegant and covered, with long sleeves or modest necklines.
